# Public law as infrastructure for innovation

::: {.lede}
My research asks how constitutional and administrative law shape the state's
capacity to direct innovation towards public purposes.
:::

::: {.todo}
Placeholder. Replace the paragraph below with two or three paragraphs on the
research agenda, then keep the sections that apply and delete the rest.
:::

Doctoral research at UCL's Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose examining
the legal conditions under which public institutions can invest, experiment, and
share in the rewards of innovation — and the constitutional and administrative
constraints that bear on them.

## Research interests

- Administrative law and regulatory design
- Comparative constitutional law
- Public purpose innovation and mission-oriented policy
- Socio-legal methods and policy analysis
- State capacity and the law of public administration
